answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the gale log makes public the live set and the spiral audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 317 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 278 aliases alive therefore means 278 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the delta quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
